newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK fund assn denies secret vote on Jardine Fleming.
newsitem.headline: HK fund assn denies secret vote on Jardine Fleming.

text.p: The Hong Kong Investment Funds Association on Wednesday denied it was holding a secret ballot to kick Jardine Fleming representatives off its board.

The industry association will announce the results of its annual election for its executive committee later today. "This so-called 'secret ballot' is not really being done," association spokeswoman Sally Wong said in response to a Hong Kong newspaper report on Wednesday.

There are 14 candidates for 12 posts, a situation that has occurred in the past, and voting is by mail, Wong said. Jardine Fleming had one seat on the 12-member committee last year. The association allows each member company to nominate one representative to the committee. Elections are held each August.
Wong said this year's election started in early August as usual. Nominations were not influenced by the Jardine Fleming scandal, which erupted last week, she said.
"There isn't any particular relationship," she said.

Jardine Fleming, equally owned by the Jardine Matheson and Robert Fleming groups, was slapped with heavy fines and had the authorisation of its London-based fund management company revoked last week following revelations of trading irregularities by one of its senior fund managers.
